visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up, appetizing shot of a stacked "Snow Q Biscuit," showing a mixture of golden biscuit chunks, white creamy binder, and dark red dried berries. The lighting is bright and warm. (2) A pair of hands wearing transparent plastic gloves breaks round, crispy biscuits into smaller irregular pieces over a clear glass bowl in a kitchen setting. (3) The hands proceed to pour a bowl of dried red cranberries and a cup of white milk powder into the bowl containing the crushed biscuits. (4) The gloved hands thoroughly toss and mix the dry ingredients together inside the bowl to ensure even distribution. (5) A block of yellow butter is placed into a black speckled non-stick pan using a wooden spatula, where it begins to melt over a stove. (6) A large amount of white cylindrical marshmallows is added to the melted butter in the pan and stirred continuously with the wooden spatula until they reach a soft, melted, and gooey consistency. (7) The pre-mixed biscuit and cranberry dry ingredients are poured into the pan with the melted marshmallows, and the hands stir the entire mass until every piece is coated in the sticky white mixture. (8) The warm mixture is transferred onto a rectangular baking tray lined with white parchment paper, and the hands use the paper to press the mixture down firmly and evenly. (9) After cooling, a large stainless steel kitchen knife is used to slice the firm block into small, uniform square pieces on a dark surface. (10) The video ends with a final close-up of a single biscuit being lifted, demonstrating its chewy, stringy texture as it is pulled apart.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 雪Q餅. [Logo]: wecook123. (2) [Subtitle]: 奇福餅乾 200g. (3) [Subtitle]: 把奇福餅乾捏碎. (4) [Subtitle]: 蔓越莓果乾 60g. [Subtitle]: 奶粉 50g. (5) [Subtitle]: 將食材攪拌均勻. (6) [Subtitle]: 無鹽奶油 60g. [Subtitle]: 棉花糖 50g. (7) [Subtitle]: 小火煮至融化. (8) [Subtitle]: 把火關掉後. [Subtitle]: 再把食材攪拌均勻. (9) [Subtitle]: 把食材鋪在. [Subtitle]: 烤盤上壓平後放涼.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a bright, mid-tempo acoustic pop track featuring a strummed guitar and a steady rhythmic beat. A male narrator introduces the recipe with a clear, friendly, and instructive tone. (2) A sharp, percussive cracking sound is heard as the dry biscuits are physically snapped. This is followed by the rustling of plastic gloves and the sound of biscuit pieces falling into a glass bowl. (3) A soft, grainy pouring sound occurs as milk powder and cranberries are added to the bowl, followed by a rhythmic stirring sound as the dry ingredients clatter against the glass. (4) A low-frequency sizzling sound emerges as butter is placed into a warm pan, followed by the soft, sticky sound of marshmallows being stirred as they melt into a thick paste. (5) As the biscuit mixture is added to the pan, a heavy, dragging sound of the wooden spatula folding the dense ingredients together is audible over the continuous BGM. (6) A series of crisp, crunchy cutting sounds follow as a knife slices through the firm, cooled biscuit block, concluding with the narrator's enthusiastic summary of the recipe's ease.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a concise and visually appealing step-by-step tutorial for making 'Snow Q Biscuits,' a popular Asian snack. It uses high-quality close-ups and clear instructions to demonstrate that the recipe is simple and achievable at home.
